mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds the 75th percentile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profits and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and unemployment is falling (UNRATE < 5.0%), the market interprets this as a strong economic expansion supported by monetary policy, amplifying positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and UNRATE < 5.0%) occurs in more than 30% of 20-day windows, but the average 20-day forward return is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a housing starts level above 1000.0 thousand units (HOUST) signals robust residential construction activity that supports consumer spending and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, HOUST above 1000.0 thousand units is not associated with positive 60-day forward returns (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110.0 (INDPRO) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds the 75th percentile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential sales and rentals (RSAFS > 350,000 million) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) indicates strong consumer demand and accommodative monetary policy, amplifying positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (RSAFS > 350,000 million and FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) occurs in more than 30% of 20-day windows, but the average 20-day forward return is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 215), a higher level of the consumer price index compresses real corporate profits and prompts aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 215), the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.
